messages:
sam: Heads up — warmpool bootstorm in us-west-2 starting ~09:12 UTC. ~30% of new nodes failing decrypt with keystore 504s. KMS logs show DENY for our keystore role around the same time. Possible correlation with the egress tightening that went out at 09:05.

infra-bot: Alert: instance-keystore-proxy-rotation failed 504 x24 in 10m. Metric: keystore_decrypt_errors +24%.

priya: Oncall — looking now. Can we revert the egress rule on prod-ephemeral-sg? Which rule changed exactly?

sam: maria applied `egress-deny: restrict-to-172.16.0.0/12` to prod-ephemeral-sg (rolled at 09:05). When I curl the keystore endpoint from a new warmnode I get: `curl https://keystore-usw2.internal/v1/decrypt -x 172.16.5.1:3128 -> 502` and proxy logs show upstream timeouts.

alex: Also seeing conntrack spikes on the NATGW when retries kick in — connections pile up from retries. If we reopen egress to keystore endpoints we should see immediate mitigation. Longer-term: PrivateLink or VPC endpoint would avoid NAT costs/conntrack.

maria: I pushed the egress change to reduce blast radius after we saw noisy outbound to broad external endpoints. I can roll it back, but note we sampled VPC flow logs down to 5% last night to cut costs, so auditing that window will be rough.

ops-oncall: Rollback approved for immediate mitigation. Proposed quick plan:
1) revert egress deny on prod-ephemeral-sg (allow keystore endpoints)
2) bump NATGW scaling / increase conntrack table on warmpool nodes
3) enable local keystore cache on warmpool (ttl=10m) to reduce calls during boot
4) follow-up: re-evaluate flow log sampling and implement an allowlist for keystore endpoints to preserve auditability.
Estimated extra NAT cost if we re-open fully: ~$1.8k/day peak. Allowlist approach: ~$120/day.

priya: I'm running `terraform apply -target=module.sg.prod-egress` now and will patch warm-pool to enable local cache. Deploy ETA 09:30 UTC.

sam: Pasting a short snippet from the failing proxy log for visibility:
```
2024-11-03T09:12:19Z keystore-proxy ERROR decrypt: 504 gateway timeout -> upstream KMS denied role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/keystore-proxy
stack: proxy->keystore-usw2.internal: connection reset by peer
retrying (attempt 3/5)
```

alex: After the rollback we saw decrypt success rate recover to 98% within 4 minutes. Conntrack still elevated; I'll open an infra ticket to increase conntrack_table_size and tune TCP keepalive on warmpool images. Also recommending NATGW burst capacity config for short spikes.

maria: We should add an audit alert rule: if flow logs sampling < 10% AND keystore endpoint errors > 1% then raise PagerDuty. Otherwise we risk missing changes that block encryption calls.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: Rolling back now and monitoring. Ping me if nodes still fail. I'll track the cost delta and tag for finance review.

infra-bot: Deploybot: terraform apply finished (plan approved). Reverted security group prod-ephemeral-sg egress rule. Run ID: deploy-2024-11-03-0932.
